summary: Iteration 28: Tested Sidebar ordering + SoldierCalculator tier redesign + UnitCostModal per-tier. Sidebar order verified (BİLGİLENDİRME → HESAPLA → KOMUTANLAR → KAFES ETKİNLİK → GARNİZON → SAVAŞ → SVS EKİP). Tier selector (T11/T8/T7/T6) renders with correct aria-pressed and default T11. Tier-specific unit costs correctly fetched and used (verified 1000 soldiers computations for T11 and T8 - all match). 2-column grid confirmed (gridTemplateColumns=1fr 1fr, order [Yemek, Çelik, Odun, Benzin] row-major). Exactly 3 time boxes (Gün/Saat/Dakika), no sure-saniye element. UnitCostModal has 4 tier tabs, switching tier reloads inputs from that tier's stored values. Backend accepts tier-suffixed categories (GET/PUT /api/unit-costs/asker_egitim_t{tier} → 200; POST /api/calculations with tier-suffixed category → 200). CRITICAL BUG: history table never appears because frontend SWR key is /calculations?category=asker_egitim (base string), but backend does EXACT match and stored records are asker_egitim_t11 / _t8 / _t7 / _t6 → SWR returns [] → calc-history-table conditional never renders. globalMutate after save also targets the same wrong key.

minor.issue: Category param uses exact match. Frontend expects to fetch all tier variants via base 'asker_egitim' key. Either (a) support prefix/starts-with query, or (b) frontend must fetch per tier / by tier-suffixed category.

ui_bugs.issue: calc-history-table never renders. useSWR('/calculations?category=asker_egitim') returns [] because backend exact-matches category and actual records are 'asker_egitim_t11', 'asker_egitim_t8', etc. Confirmed via curl: GET /api/calculations?category=asker_egitim → count 0, but GET /api/calculations?category=asker_egitim_t11 → count 2.

globalMutate('/calculations?category=asker_egitim') after save/delete is a no-op vs. the per-tier query the user actually needs; even if history query is fixed to per-tier, this mutate key needs to change accordingly.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/calculations succeeds (verified 200 with row inserted in DB) but UI history is invisible due to wrong SWR key.

action_items: Fix SoldierCalculator history query: change useSWR key to per-tier `/calculations?category=asker_egitim_${tier.toLowerCase()}` and mutate same key on save/delete. Alternative: change backend to accept category as prefix, e.g. add ?category_prefix param or interpret 'asker_egitim' as prefix match.
If history should show ALL tiers merged, implement Promise.all fetch across the 4 tier categories and merge in-memory (SWR key like '/calculations/asker_egitim_all').
critical_code_review_comments: SoldierCalculator.jsx line 37 & 59 & 67: hardcoded '/calculations?category=asker_egitim' does not match any stored record because POST always writes with tier suffix — dead query. This is the primary bug.

Verified computations correct against current DB unit-costs: T11 (yemek=18500, odun=12100, celik=3734, benzin=483, sure_saniye=180) × 1000 soldiers = 18.500.000 / 12.100.000 / 3.734.000 / 483.000; time 180000s → 02g 02s 00d. T8 (100/50/30/20/5) × 1000 → 100.000 / 50.000 / 30.000 / 20.000; 5000s → 00g 01s 24d (ceil). All match UI output.
T11 default selection, aria-pressed toggling, and gradient background all work.
Modal per-tier switching reloads values via SWR key derived from activeTier — verified (T11:18500, T8:100, T7:50).
Sidebar section order confirmed via screenshot: BİLGİLENDİRME → HESAPLA → KOMUTANLAR → KAFES ETKİNLİK → GARNİZON → SAVAŞ → SVS EKİP.
Note: Review request stated T11 preseed {yemek:200,...} but current DB has yemek=18500. Someone/main agent updated T11 costs between spec write and test. Not a defect.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The single remaining bug is the history table SWR key mismatch. After fix, verify: (1) save creates a row visible in calc-history-table with Tier column showing 'T11' via tierOf() regex parse; (2) Süre column uses formatSureShort 'Xg YYs ZZd'; (3) mutate refresh works; (4) delete-calc-{id} removes row. All other flows already verified.
rca of the issue: SoldierCalculator.jsx fetches useSWR('/calculations?category=asker_egitim', ...) — a static string with no tier suffix. But POST /api/calculations writes docs with tier-suffixed category (e.g., 'asker_egitim_t11'). The backend list endpoint at server.py:1108 uses db.calculations.find({'category': category}) — EXACT match. Hence GET /api/calculations?category=asker_egitim returns []. The conditional `calculations.length > 0` at line 186 evaluates false and calc-history-table is never rendered. Mitigation A (frontend): make the SWR key dynamic to current tier (`/calculations?category=${category}`) so each tier shows its own history. Mitigation B (frontend, if merged view desired): fetch all four tier categories in parallel and merge. Mitigation C (backend): add prefix support (e.g., `startswith` filter) or a dedicated /calculations/by-prefix endpoint.
